subject.title: [Feature]: Support direct video upload to LLM

question: Should OpenClaw support provider-native video as a first-class chat/model input, and if so through which core/plugin contract plus security and fallback policy?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix crosses product API shape, provider routing, model capability metadata, raw-media egress, retention, and fallback behavior that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Approve First-Class Video Input
options.body: Define a coherent WebChat/Gateway/model-catalog/provider contract with security limits, then land or replace an implementation that follows it.

options.title: Keep Video In Media Understanding
options.body: Defer direct chat/model video uploads and document the existing video.description file-analysis path instead.

options.title: Prove Provider Plugins First
options.body: Let provider-specific implementations prove native video behavior behind provider-owned seams before adding a generic core chat-video content contract.

recommendation.title: Approve First-Class Video Input
recommendation.body: Define a coherent WebChat/Gateway/model-catalog/provider contract with security limits, then land or replace an implementation that follows it.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest current-main blame and visible routing context for the WebChat/Gateway/provider boundary involved here.
